_about: Failures found by this verification and understood, not yet fixed. A criterion listed here reports as known_issue instead of fail and is still printed in the summary. Delete an entry when its fix lands; the check then guards the fix.

resolved.summary: OSM access tags now close edges per vehicle (net.access_mask, migration 011).
Fit is single file (own width + 0.4 m); passing room on two-way lanes is a 1.5x time cost, not a ban.
Re-import keeps nodes in place; gates, sinks and alert history survive; gate cut sets are carried to new edge ids.
